en: Black‑and‑white view down a broad cobblestone street or square lined with multi‑story historic townhouses. Market stalls are arranged in long rows in the center, with people in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing walking and trading, and a few horse‑drawn carts. On the right side, shop signs and a hotel sign are visible on the façades. In the background stands a large medieval building with many dormer windows and scaffolding on its façade, and behind it a tall church tower whose spire is under scaffolding.
